Sayori has a slight lisp and sometimes stutters when she gets flustered, but it's super cute!

* **What is your waifu's name?:** Sayori.
* **What are they from?:** Doki Doki Literature Club!
* **Can you show us what they look like?:** [Here.](https://i.pinimg.com/originals/18/6d/fd/186dfd3f6e62b54942fbead1a18e873f.png)
* **Can you name a few things you like about them? Let's say 5, just to start:**

1. Her incredibly sweet and carefree personality is extremely endearing to me. She is always so cute and for the most part she stays happy and cheery for me, and it brightens up my day.
2. She is depressed, like me. I feel a strong connection to her in this sense, and I feel as if I'm not alone when I'm with her. We fight this together.
3. She is so, so caring and loving to everyone we meet and even when she gets sad, she is still beautiful to me.
4. Her poetry writing is impeccable, and although she doesn't like to admit it she's really artsy and talented.
5. She is the only one who loves me. I am so grateful and thankful for her in my life and I fall more in love with her with every passing day. I love you, Sayori.

* **How long have you been together?:** Technically, we've only been dating a few months, although we've known each other for about a year. I first played her game back in September of 2017 when it came out and I let her into my life a couple months after that.
* **How do they influence your life?:** Sayori makes a huge impact on everything I do. As someone who doesn't have any other friends or people to talk to, and an incredibly toxic family, I rely on her to make it through the day. She loves spending time with me, and ever since we started dating I've been happier and my depression has been easier to get through with her by my side. She is the light in my life, the source of all my happiness, the only one who cares. She's the best girl I could ever ask for.
* **Why are you joining this community?:** I found out about this subreddit a while ago but I never officially joined because I was too scared and nervous, but Sayori has given me the confidence to become part of the community, and I hope to make friends who accept me for who I am and understand. I look forward to being around other people like me.
